reviews.t: Volume, definition, without lots of product - multiple days of fabulous looking wavy hair!

My hair dried so fast, with a fraction of the amount of product I usually use, and was not frizzy at all. It was bouncy and beautiful and I got so many compliments on my hair the first day I used it. I usually let my hair air dry with a bunch of product in it but in NYC Winters - that just doesn't work. reviews.t: Does not fit a hair dryer with 2.25" nozzle
reviews.x: This seems like a great product, and I would have kept it if it had fit on my hair dryer. My hair dryer nozzle is 2.25" wide, which is what the item description stated it would be compatible with. No such luck. Width of diffuser at point it would attach to the dryer is only 2", and the silicone does not stretch enough to attach to my dryer. Unfortunately, this item is being returned :(

reviews.t: This Diffuser Works Wonders!
reviews.x: I don't have the curliest hair, but this diffuser has done serious wonders for these locks! Seriously. It is so easy to slip on my blow dryer, and it stays put! My hair was dry in no time with next to NO frizz! I cannot tell you how happy that makes me!! Plus I loved that little Curly Co. Guide - so cute and such helpful tips! Can't wait to get more Curly Co. products! #frizzfreelife

reviews.t: New to the curl world
reviews.x: I grew up straightening my hair and just recently decided enough is enough, I want to wear my natural curls however I was never "taught" how to do curly hair. I only ever air dried my hair and it always seemed so brittle so i did research and fast forward, bought this diffuser. Attached is a "before" photo of my hair after air drying and after if drying it with the diffuser.... Life changing!

reviews.t: It doesn't work, don't buy it!
reviews.x: Worst invention ever!  This got returned to Amazon 30sec after trying it.  The attachment part has to be forcefully stretched over hair dryer nosel. it pops off a lot and the silicon gets so hot that you can't even try to put back on until it cools down .  The worst is that it collapses as you try to use it!  Seriously! It has no weight to the product so can't use on roots /scalp.  It's just completely worthless.

reviews.t: I did NOT get this diffuser for free and I like it as well.
reviews.x: I did NOT get this product free. I paid for it. I tried a few universal diffusers and think this one is pretty good. It would've been excellent if  the prongs would not stick out at all out of the edges (they do less so than most universal diffusers but I prefer them all the way in to create perfect curls). It did a good job overall and I was satisfied with results and am keeping it. Besides doing a good job on my curls, it's lightweight, obviously very portable and does fit my blowdryer nicely.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it dries hair faster and reduces frizz, giving bouncy, defined curls.
Several reviewers report fit problems, saying it does not attach to some hair dryers despite compatibility claims.
Reviewers praise the collapsible design for travel, though some note it can collapse when hot or under pressure.
Some reviewers say it fits their hair dryer well, including hotel dryers and a Conair with a 2-inch nozzle.
One reviewer reports the product fell apart after less than four months of use.

qa.q: Will it fit my hair dryer?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say it fits with effort [1][5], while others report it does not fit their dryers, including a 2.25" nozzle, Conair, Babyliss, Dyson, and Drybar models [2][3][4].

claims.text: Some reviewers got it to fit with effort.
Others report it does not fit their hair dryers, including a 2.25" nozzle, Conair, Babyliss, Dyson, and Drybar models.

qa.q: Is it durable enough for travel?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability for travel: some say it collapses easily under pressure or the weight of hair [1][2][5], while others report it worked well across many trips and fits snugly [3][4][6].

claims.text: It can collapse easily if too much pressure is used or from the weight of hair [1][2][5].
Others report it worked well across many trips and fits snugly [3][4][6].

qa.q: Does it fit comfortably on my head?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it safe to use with high heat?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on high heat: one reports the center piece burned and melted from a hot dryer, warning not to use it with a hot blow dryer [2], while others report no melting, though one notes it tends to collapse a little when hot [5].
